name: 2S Black Bean & Burdock Soy Sauce
summary: The first soy sauce **naturally fermented from Vietnamese green-kernel black beans and burdock root** grown in Soc Son. After **99 days of traditional fermentation**, it becomes a flavorful, wholesome sauce for everyone – whether you eat a regular or a plant-based diet.
highlights: Green-kernel black beans & Soc Son burdock

sections.title: Ingredients
sections.text: Water, black beans (200g/l), burdock (60g/l), salt, palm sugar, golden camellia tea, preservative, natural flavor enhancers from fermentation (no industrial additives).

sections.title: Certification & awards
items: All-natural product – certified 100% natural by VNPS (code TN.TP.23.01.01).
Producer: Soc Son Medicinal Herb Conservation and Development Cooperative – certified to Vietnam Organic and Japan Organic (J.A.S.) standards.

sections.title: How to use
sections.text: Use as a dipping sauce, in dressings, or as a seasoning for marinating, braising and stir-frying. Suitable for both regular and plant-based diets.

badges: Black beans & burdock lab-tested at NIFC
Black beans: Aflatoxin not detected; 3 pesticide residues tested
pitch: Naturally fermented for 99 days from black beans and burdock

proofs.title: Raw material test reports for black beans and burdock root
proofs.org: National Institute for Food Control (NIFC) – Ministry of Health
proofs.scope: Black beans: Aflatoxin B1, total Aflatoxin, Carbendazim, Propargite and Tebuconazole not detected. These are raw material tests
